name: Voice-command transcript classification
summary: Classify a transcribed command's intent for a downstream dispatcher.

input.state: The transcript text as the recognizer produced it.

criteria.unknown: No listed intent fits; ignore the command.

confident.instructions: The transcript is clean enough to act on - no garbled or truncated phrasing.
confident.criteria: Answer yes only when the state supports it; otherwise no.

uncertainty.abstain: a garbled transcript is ignored - acting on misheard words is worse than missing a command
uncertainty.refusal: a refused transcript reports refused and is ignored

limits: Classifies transcripts; it is not speech recognition and cannot judge audio the recognizer dropped.
Dispatch is the caller's - an intent name is a label, not an executed action.

examples.api: POST /v1/systemone per item, or /v1/classify with items as inputs
examples.mcp: oak-mcp ask tool with the same envelope

evidence.label: unmeasured
evidence.note: Composition is verified over recorded answers by crates/gym/tests/recipes.rs; model-quality measurement runs through a gym suite and is pinned here only when it exists.
